description: This file defines a Java service class named RouteService that interacts with the OpenRouteService API to obtain optimized driving routes based on given coordinates. It constructs an HTTP request with a JSON payload, sends it, and processes the JSON response to extract route details such as distance, duration, and geometry.

classes.name: RouteService
classes.description: A Spring service component responsible for fetching optimized routes from the OpenRouteService API using specified start and end coordinates.

methods.name: getOptimizedRoute
methods.description: Constructs and sends a POST request to the routing API with provided start and end coordinates, then parses the response to create and return a RouteResponse object containing distance, duration, and geometry.
